findings.location: Near end, paragraph: "God had a plan for Ken and I. God wanted to show Ken that He loved him and that He would be there for him even when Josh turned his back on Him."
findings.source_quote: "God had a plan for Ken and I. God wanted to show Ken that He loved him and that He would be there for him even when Josh turned his back on Him."
findings.suggested_fix: Change the French verb mood/tense to match the past sense of the English source. For example, replace « même lorsque Josh détournerait le dos » with « même lorsque Josh lui tourna le dos » or « même si Josh lui tourna le dos ». Preserve surrounding HTML and punctuation exactly.
findings.translation_quote: "Dieu avait un plan pour Ken et pour moi. Dieu voulait montrer à Ken qu’Il l’aimait et qu’Il serait là pour lui même lorsque Josh détournerait le dos."
